text:
gina: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem — looks like two distinct failure modes repeating: (a) manifests missing the audit annotation, and (b) a small set of service tokens that escaped the rotation schedule. Creating this thread to pin owners, short deadlines, and a simple metric for closure.

omar: thanks. Can we keep the first pass minimal: emergency sweep + infra gate + smoke metrics?

gina: Proposed split: 
  - emergency sweep + safe rotator (owner @omar) — dry-run today, staged run tomorrow.
  - infra admission gate that denies manifests without `audit/logs:enabled` in prod (owner @sylvie) — PR by Tue.
  - CI lint + integration smoke that calls token-introspect (owner @rob) — target Fri.
  - dashboard metric + alert (owner @kevin) — show percent services with audit-hook + weekly rotated tokens.

omar: I'll take the rotator. Plan: dry-run reports candidates and stores a CSV; only proceed with manual approval. Will support `--dry-run`, `--max-parallel`, and `--introspect-timeout`. ETA: dry-run tonight.

sylvie: I'll scope the gate to prod-namespaces first and add an allowlist for infra-managed legacy services. PR will include a migration doc.

rob: CI side: adding a manifest linter rule and a quick integration that hits introspect endpoint and asserts expected status codes after simulated rotation. Also adding a flakiness guard so CI doesn't block on transient introspect 5xx.

kevin: I'll build a small dashboard: `authz.audit_hook_coverage_pct` and `authz.rotated_tokens_weekly`. Alert if coverage < 95% for 3d. Owner: @kevin. ETA: 3 business days.

sec-bot: security: Created SEC-1314 "Audit annotation gate + rotator sweep" and linked incident-712. Priority: P2.

gina: Manual fallback: If rotator errors in prod, we run the manual rotation steps in the runbook and page SRE. Can someone draft that runbook? @rob?

rob: I'll draft the manual runbook and include checklist items: (1) dry-run verification, (2) `--max-parallel` tuning, (3) rollback contact list. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

omar: Helper command I used to enumerate tokens: `kubectl get secrets -A -l redwood/service-token -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name}{"\n"}{end}'` — will attach CSV snapshot after the dry-run.

sylvie: Draft PR for admission gate posted: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/401 — includes exception annotation `infra.redwood/legacy=true`. Please review.

rob: Runbook draft: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/token-rotation-emergency.md — includes manual revoke/recreate steps and escalation matrix.

kevin: Dashboard link (initial): https://dash.redwood/internal/authz/coverage — will add weekly summary.

gina: Quick closure criteria: >95% audit_hook_coverage for 2 consecutive weeks + rotator candidates < 5/week for 2 weeks. If we hit that, we close the follow-up.

omar: Dry-run complete — candidates CSV uploaded: https://internal.redwood/ops/rotator/dryrun/1767778888.csv. No mass-revokes in dry-run. Scheduling staged run for tomorrow 03:00Z with `--max-parallel=3`.

sylvie: Noted. One ask: rotator should mark rotated tokens with `rotation.initiator` telemetry field so Security can trace actions. Can you add that, @omar?

omar: Yes. Will emit `rotation.initiator=rotator-v1` and `rotation.mode=dry_run|forced` tags.

rob: CI PR posted: https://git.internal/redwood/ci/pull/89. Integration harness mocks introspect and supports a dry-run smoke test.

kevin: Added alert: `authz_audit_coverage_low` firing if coverage <95% for 72h. Also added `rotator_failure_rate` graph.

gina: Scheduling quick sync Thu 09:00 PT to confirm PR reviews and runbook readiness. If blocked, drop a short update here before 08:30 PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sec-bot: security: Noted SRE drill recommended after rollout. Recommend a manual rotation drill within 2 weeks to validate runbook.

omar: Acknowledged — will coordinate with SRE for drill scheduling.

sylvie: Reviewing infra PR now. Will post comments.

gina: Great progress. We'll use this thread as the single source of truth until checklist is green.
